title: Reversa Pricing Profile
description: Billing profile generated by agent reversa-pricing-profile, consumed by agents reversa-pricing-size and reversa-pricing-estimate.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of profile creation or last regeneration.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of operation code.

hourly_rate.description: Net hourly rate in local currency.

hourly_rate_mode.description: direct = user entered the amount; derived = calculated from monthly_target_income and billable_hours_per_month.

monthly_target_income.description: Desired net monthly income in local currency. Required when hourly_rate_mode = derived, null otherwise.

billable_hours_per_month.description: Estimated billable hours per month. Required when hourly_rate_mode = derived, null otherwise.

margin_percent.description: Project markup over direct cost, in percentage. The historical name of the field remains margin_percent for compatibility.

tax_regime.description: Canonical key of the tax regime documented in references/tax-regimes.md, or 'other'.

tax_factor.description: Approximate tax factor associated with the scheme. Applied by the Pricer on the direct cost.

tax_factor_kind.description: Factor type: approximate effective reserve, simplified legal proxy, or tax not computed.

tax_factor_source.description: Public source or internal catalog that supports the approximate factor.

includes_vat.description: Indicates whether the factor combines income/contribution tax with VAT/VAT/ISS highlighted.

vat_pass_through_warning.description: Indicates whether the estimate should warn that part of the tax can be passed on to the customer and not reduce the margin.

tax_regime_confidence.description: high = user chose explicitly; low = fallback suggestion or 'other'.

client_profile.description: May be empty when user chooses to skip this question.

billing_currency.description: Currency in which the user charges the customer when different from currency. null when charging in local currency.

exchange_rate_to_local.description: Manual exchange: how many units of currency are worth 1 unit of billing_currency. null when not charged in foreign currency.
